page: Microsoft Azure M64bs_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual server belonging to the MBSMediumMemoryv3 family. It is configured with 64 dedicated vCPUs, derived from 32 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled on an Intel Xeon 8473C processor running at a clock speed of 4.0 GHz. The architecture is x86_64, supported by a Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system features 512.0 GB of RAM, establishing a 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio. There is no local storage bundled with this instance; however, it is Premium Storage capable and optimized for block storage performance.

In benchmark evaluations, the server exhibits strong memory and computational performance. It achieves a memory bandwidth of 4509.44 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 216.83 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, alongside a write bandwidth of 92.52 GB/sec. Database operations are highly efficient, with Passmark database tests scoring 29566.23 and Redis SET operations reaching 71.51 million operations per second. Single-threaded gzip compression performs at 33.18 GB/sec, while multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reaches 342.84 GB/sec. Image processing benchmarks place the server in the top tier with a score of 18634.0.

The qualitative cost profile of the M64bs_v3 reflects its high-density memory allocation and dedicated compute resources. By omitting local storage, the instance avoids unnecessary hardware overhead for environments that rely entirely on network-attached block storage. This resource configuration is highly suited for memory-intensive enterprise workloads, including large-scale relational databases, in-memory caching systems, data analytics pipelines, and high-throughput web serving.
